subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements is correct regarding badminton?

I. At the beginning of the game of badminton and when the score is even, the server serves from the left service court.

II. Server and receiver always stand in opposite service courts but on the same side.
solution:
The correct answer is __**4 Neither I nor II**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement I:** At the beginning of the game of badminton and when the score is even, the server serves from the left service court.

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. In badminton, the server serves from the right service court when the score is even and from the left service court when the score is odd.
 
 
 
• **Statement II:** Server and receiver always stand in opposite service courts but on the same side.
 
 
• This statement is also incorrect. The server and receiver stand in diagonally opposite service courts, not on the same side.
 
 

Therefore, neither Statement I nor Statement II is correct.
